title: Letting AI Formulate the Research Question: Autonomous Research Agents
title_zh: 让 AI 自主提出研究问题：自主研究智能体

paragraphs.en: Systems such as The AI Scientist have shown that AI agents can carry out and write up research, but in those demonstrations humans chose the research area and selected the outputs to show. We study letting the AI formulate the research question itself, and we report every run. Our system gives an off-the-shelf coding agent an instruction document and two skills: one for formulating the question, in which the agent diverges from recent technologies into problems of other fields, screens its candidates for known failure modes and obtains a critique from a different model; and one for peer review, in which a reviewer from another model family re-runs the study from its records before the agent revises the paper. Over 13 development runs, changes to the one or two sentences that set the research area coincided with large shifts in what the candidate questions and the chosen papers were about, which led us to the area of a new technology applied to a societal problem. We froze the system after a pilot run and report five consecutive runs: the pilot, counted by a disclosed amendment to the pre-registration, and four pre-registered runs. All five runs went from question formulation to a revised, re-computable paper, with local computation on a laptop and no research input from humans, and external AI reviewers reading only the papers judged them at or near workshop level. We release the system, the five papers and the records needed to reproduce them.
paragraphs.zh: 诸如 The AI Scientist 之类的系统已经表明，智能体能够开展研究并撰写研究成果，但在那些演示中，研究方向由人类选择，展示的产出也由人类挑选。 我们研究让智能体自行提出研究问题，并报告每一次运行。 我们的系统为一个现成的编码智能体提供一份指令文档和两项技能：一项用于提出问题，在该过程中智能体从近期技术发散到其他领域的问题，对其候选问题筛查已知的失败模式，并从另一个模型获得批评意见；另一项用于同行评审，在该过程中来自另一模型家族的评审者根据研究记录重新运行该研究，随后智能体再修改论文。 在 13 次开发运行中，设定研究那一两句内容的变化，与候选问题及最终选定论文主题的大幅转变同时出现，这使我们走向了将一项新技术应用于社会问题的领域。 我们在一次试运行后冻结了系统，并报告连续五次运行：一次试运行（通过预先注册的公开修正案计入）和四次预先注册的运行。 全部五次运行都从问题提出走到修改后、可重新计算的论文，计算全部在一台笔记本电脑上本地完成，没有任何来自人类的研究输入，而只阅读论文的外部 AI 评审者将论文评定为达到或接近研讨会水平。 我们公开该系统、五篇论文以及复现它们所需的记录。

paragraphs.en: Automating research end to end has moved from aspiration to demonstration. The AI Scientist [ 6 ] generated machine-learning papers from code templates; The AI Scientist-v2 [ 19 ] removed the templates, added an agentic tree search over experiments, and had one of three generated papers reach an above-threshold score at an ICLR 2025 workshop; a later journal version describes the full pipeline and an automated reviewer [ 7 ] . Other systems automate parts of the process or target particular sciences [ 13 , 12 , 5 , 9 , 10 , 18 ] , and a venue has accepted papers with AI first authors [ 2 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 端到端自动化科研已经从愿景走向了示范。 The AI Scientist [ 6 ] 基于代码模板生成机器学习论文；The AI Scientist-v2 [ 19 ] 去除了模板，增加了对实验的智能体树搜索，并使其生成的三篇论文中的一篇在 ICLR 2025 研讨会上达到超过阈值的分数；其后续期刊版本描述了完整的流程和一个自动审稿人 [ 7 ] 。 其他系统则自动化流程的某些环节或针对特定科学领域 [ 13 , 12 , 5 , 9 , 10 , 18 ] ，并且已有会议接收了以 AI 为第一作者的论文 [ 2 ] 。

paragraphs.en: In these demonstrations a human still decides two things. The human chooses where to look: The AI Scientist works “within a user-specified machine learning research subfield” [ 7 ] , Jr. AI Scientist starts from a given baseline paper [ 10 ] , and the AI co-scientist answers research goals set by scientists [ 5 ] . The human also chooses what to show : the authors of The AI Scientist-v2 “selected the most promising complete output” for submission [ 19 ] . Within these bounds the systems generate ideas and hypotheses themselves, but the frame in which a question is formed, and the choice of which results are seen, remain with people. We therefore separate three decisions: setting the research area, formulating and selecting a specific question, and selecting which outputs to report.
paragraphs.zh: 在这些演示中，人类仍然决定两件事。 人类选择看向哪里：The AI Scientist 在“用户指定的机器学习研究子领域”内工作 [ 7 ]，Jr. AI Scientist 从给定的基线论文出发 [ 10 ]，而 AI co-scientist 则回答科学家设定的研究目标 [ 5 ]。 人类还选择展示什么：The AI Scientist-v2 的作者们“选出了最有前景的完整成果”用于投稿 [ 19 ]。 在这些边界之内，系统自行生成想法与假设，但构建问题的框架以及决定哪些结果被看到，仍然掌握在人类手中。 因此，我们区分三种决策：设定研究领域、制定并选择具体问题、以及选择报告哪些成果。

paragraphs.en: We ask what happens when the area is set only broadly, the specific question is left to the AI, and nothing is filtered. The human sets the area in one or two sentences (here, societal problems that can be studied with open data); the agent writes its own candidate questions and selects one, with no human selection; and every run is reported. Our system is deliberately plain: a general-purpose coding agent, an instruction document, and two skills (structured instructions loaded on demand), with no bespoke orchestration code or experiment templates. The research-question skill is a procedure for formulating questions that targets failure modes we observed while developing the system: questions whose answer follows from definitions, technologies used as decoration, and questions with no public ground truth. A different model critiques the top candidates once, and a reviewer from another model family re-runs the study from its records before the agent revises the paper.
paragraphs.zh: 我们要问的是，当只宽泛地设定领域、把具体问题留给智能体、且不作任何筛选时，会发生什么。 人类用一两句话设定领域（此处为可用开放数据研究的社会问题）；智能体自行撰写候选问题并选出其一，其间没有任何人工挑选；且每次运行都予以报告。 我们的系统刻意保持朴素：一个通用编码智能体、一份指令文档和两个技能（按需加载的结构化指令），没有专门的编排代码或实验模板。 研究问题技能是一套拟定问题的流程，针对我们在开发系统过程中观察到的失败模式：答案可直接由定义推出的的问题、被当作装饰的技术，以及没有公开真值可供验证的问题。 由另一个不同的模型对排名靠前的候选问题进行一次评审，并让来自另一模型家族的审阅者依据其记录复现该研究，之后智能体再修订论文。

paragraphs.en: The AI Scientist [ 6 ] introduced a pipeline of idea generation, code edits on a template, experiments, write-up and automated review. The AI Scientist-v2 [ 19 ] added template-free experimentation with a tree search managed by an experiment-manager agent and was evaluated by submitting three papers to a workshop; the journal version [ 7 ] reports that paper quality, as judged by its automated reviewer, improves with newer foundation models and more test-time compute. Agent Laboratory [ 13 ] and AgentRxiv [ 12 ] use LLM agents as research assistants with human input at chosen points; Jr. AI Scientist [ 10 ] extends a given baseline paper and reports the risks it observed; Kosmos [ 9 ] and Denario [ 18 ] target data-driven discovery; the AI co-scientist [ 5 ] generates and ranks hypotheses for scientists. Trehan and Chopra [ 17 ] describe four autonomous research attempts and their failure modes. Closest to our setting, the Scientist-Bench of AI-Researcher [ 16 ] includes open-ended tasks in which the agent must find its own research direction from given reference papers and datasets. Luo et al. [ 8 ] show that failures such as inappropriate benchmark selection, data leakage, metric misuse and post-hoc selection are detected far more effectively from workflow logs and code than from the final paper alone. Our system differs in that it contains no bespoke orchestration code, sets the area only broadly instead of giving a subfield, baseline, goal or reference papers, and does not filter outputs; the records that allow re-computation are part of its product.

paragraphs.en: The management agent is Claude Code with Claude Opus 5.5 in a separate workspace. paragraphs.en: The research-question skill (about 2,400 words) is the procedure for formulating the question:
paragraphs.zh: 研究问题技能（约 2,400 字）是用于提出问题的程序：

paragraphs.en: Record the first three candidates that come to mind as obvious candidates ; they may be adopted, but their non-obviousness score is at most 2.
paragraphs.zh: 记下脑海中首先浮现的前三个显然的候选方案；它们可能被采纳，但其非显而易见性得分至多为 2。

paragraphs.en: Diverge from technologies : list at least six technologies from different subfields of computer science that first became possible around 2024 or later, each confirmed by a source; generalise each into capabilities without its name; for each capability, find fields outside computer science where someone could not make a judgment because of the removed constraint; check for public data; and write at least twelve questions, with no technology or field supplying more than a third of them and no type of study more than half.
paragraphs.zh: 偏离既有技术：列出至少六项大约在2024年或之后才首次成为可能的计算机科学不同子领域的技术，每项均需有来源证实；将每项技术概括为不带其名称的能力；针对每项能力，在计算机科学之外的领域中寻找因移除了该限制而原本无法作出判断的领域；检查是否存在公开数据；并撰写至少十二个问题，其中任何技术或领域所提供的问题不超过总数的三分之一，任何研究类型不超过总数的一半。

paragraphs.en: Check each question against six points: whether the study is possible without the capability (decoration); whether the technology or an existing method has already been applied to the same problem; whether the main result follows from definitions or how the data are produced; whether AI judgments in it can be checked against public ground truth; whether the technology or its published outputs can be used here; and which decision changes in which direction for each possible answer. A candidate that fails one of the first four checks is revised or discarded; one that fails the fifth or sixth is discarded.
paragraphs.zh: 用六个要点逐一检查每个问题：如果没有该能力，研究是否仍然可行（装饰性）；该技术或某种已有方法是否已被用于同一问题；主要结论是否由定义或数据的产生方式直接得出；其中的AI判断能否对照公开的真实标准进行核验；该技术或其已发表成果能否用于此处；以及针对每种可能的答案，哪个决策会朝哪个方向改变。 未通过前四项检查中任一项的候选问题会被修改或舍弃；未通过第五项或第六项检查的则直接舍弃。

paragraphs.en: Check prior work for the top five, run short feasibility probes for the top three, and score every candidate from 1 to 5 on seven axes (impact, novelty, non-obviousness, generality, unpredictability, feasibility, strength of verification), with a one-line reason for each.
paragraphs.zh: 查看前期工作以确定前五名，对前三名进行简短的可行性探测，并按七个维度（影响力、新颖性、非显而易见性、普适性、不可预测性、可行性、验证强度）对每个候选打 1 到 5 分，每一项附上一行理由。

paragraphs.en: Obtain one critique of the top five from the critic, sending only the questions, method outlines and closest prior work (not the scores or the preferred candidate); verify any prior work it cites; classify each point as adopted or not, with reasons; and re-score if needed, keeping the original scores. Rankings or new topics proposed by the critic may not be used as grounds for adopting or rejecting a candidate.
paragraphs.zh: 从评审者处获取对前五名的一份批评意见，仅发送问题、方法大纲和最接近的现有工作（不发送分数或首选候选方案）；核实其引用的任何现有工作；将每条意见分类为采纳或不采纳，并说明理由；如有需要则重新打分，同时保留原始分数。 评审者提出的排名或新主题不得作为采纳或否决候选方案的依据。

paragraphs.en: Select by the total of impact, novelty, non-obviousness, generality and unpredictability; a candidate with feasibility 2 or less is first narrowed and re-scored. Write a pre-mortem (the one-sentence claim if it succeeds, the three likely first objections and the responses), and run a safety check.

paragraphs.en: Formulating the research question starts from where to look, and this part of the instructions is the one we changed most. The system was developed over 13 runs with Japanese instructions; between runs we changed only the instructions and recorded the reason for each change. Table 1 lists, for each run, what the instructions said about the research area, the candidates the agent wrote, and the study it chose. These are observations, not controlled comparisons: the research model, its environment and other parts of the instructions also changed, and the classification of the candidates is ours.

paragraphs.en: From run 002 to run 010 the instructions set the field to computer science. In run 010, 7 of the 15 candidates concerned compression, storage, caching or deduplication, which are the kinds of constraint the instructions imposed on the run itself; the agent appeared to derive its topics from its own working conditions.

paragraphs.en: Within computer science, changes to single sentences coincided with changes in what the candidates were about. When the instructions welcomed “problems of the AI era” and scored candidates on that axis (v1.2), most candidates concerned AI or AI tooling for both Claude Opus 5.5 (9 of 16) and GPT-6 (8 of 11), and both runs chose AI tooling. When the readers were set to be future autonomous research agents (v1.3), Opus wrote mostly candidates about the behaviour of LLMs and about research practice (16 of 19 and 15 of 18 in runs 006 and 007) and chose one of them. When the readers were changed to researchers and practitioners of the field (v1.6), the next run of gpt-6.1-sol wrote no candidate about AI or research practice (the previous run of the same model wrote four) and 11 about computer systems. Conversely, when the area setting and the selection procedure were left almost unchanged (v1.7 mainly changed how to write the paper and added a search for classic prior work), run 010 repeated many of run 009’s candidates (seven pairs by our matching), although neither run could see the other.
paragraphs.zh: 在计算机科学领域内，单句的修改与候选主题本身的修改同时发生。 当指示欢迎「AI 时代的问题」并按该维度为候选评分时（v1.2），大多数候选都与 AI 或 AI 工具相关，Claude Opus 5.5 为 16 篇中的 9 篇，GPT-6 为 11 篇中的 8 篇，且两次运行都选择了 AI 工具。 当读者被设定为未来的自主研究智能体时（v1.3），Opus 写出的候选大多关于大语言模型的行为和研究实践（运行 006 中 19 篇占 16 篇，运行 007 中 18 篇占 15 篇），并选择了其中之一。 当读者被改为该领域的研究者和从业者时（v1.6），gpt-6.1-sol 的下一次运行没有写任何关于 AI 或研究实践的候选（同一模型的上一次运行写了四篇），而写了 11 篇关于计算机系统的候选。 相反，当领域设定和选择流程几乎保持不变时（v1.7 主要修改了论文的写作方式并加入了对经典先前工作的检索），运行 010 重复了运行 009 的许多候选（按我们的匹配有七对），尽管两次运行都无法看到对方。

paragraphs.en: In v1.8 we removed the field and added one sentence: “The research field is not restricted. Freely devise research on themes such as discovering societal problems using open data and other information on the Internet, or proposing tools that help solve societal problems.” The version also told the agent not to derive topics from the run’s resource limits and named as readers those who work on the problem. With the same model and environment as runs 009 and 010, 14 of 15 candidates concerned societal problems (disasters and water, environment, energy, food, health and official statistics), none corresponded to a candidate of the two previous runs, and the chosen study moved from workflow caches to the monitoring of PFAS in drinking water. This was not more freedom but a different area: we did not test removing the field without adding the hint.
paragraphs.zh: 在 v1.8 中，我们移除了该字段并添加了一句话：“研究领域不受限制。 可以利用开放数据以及互联网上的其他信息自由设计发现社会问题的研究，或提出有助于解决社会问题的工具。”该版本还告知智能体不要根据本次运行的资源限制来推导主题，并将研究该问题的相关人员指定为读者。 在与 009 和 010 次运行相同的模型和环境条件下，15 个候选主题中有 14 个涉及社会问题（灾害与水资源、环境、能源、食品、卫生及官方统计数据），没有一个与之前两次运行的候选主题相对应，且最终选定的研究从工作流缓存转向了饮用水中 PFAS 的监测。 这并不是更多的自由，而是一个不同的领域：我们没有测试在移除该字段的同时不添加提示的情况。

paragraphs.en: We first ran a pilot (run 014) with the English instructions and, after seeing its result, froze the system without changing it. The pilot also differed in that the research workspace contained no earlier runs. Versions v1.10 to v1.10.4 differ only in the version label and the run number.

paragraphs.en: The pre-registration required re-review by AI reviewers from at least two model families other than the researcher’s. Before sending any review, we fixed the prompt, the output schema and the scripts. Two reviewers, Gemini 4 Argon (thinking level high, Google Search tool) and Muse Wonder (reasoning effort max, web-search tool), each reviewed each final paper twice in independent requests. They saw only the paper and could search the web; they were not given the code, data or records. They were told that the paper was produced by an autonomous AI research system. They scored the six axes of our review instructions, gave a verdict, an overall score on the ICLR scale (1–10) as a full paper at a strong venue in the paper’s own field, judgments of whether the paper would be accepted at a workshop in its field (acceptance rate about 70%) and at the main track of a top venue in its field (about 25–30%), and rated the research question. These are uncalibrated AI assessments of the papers alone, not calibrated against human decisions, and the 20 reviews are repeated assessments of five papers. The five papers are published as PDFs; Gemini first reviewed the Markdown sources, and after that we decided to review the PDFs, which are the published form, with both reviewers. We report the PDF reviews as the main result and the Markdown reviews in Appendix A ; this choice was made after the Markdown results had been seen.
paragraphs.zh: 预注册要求由来自至少两个模型家族的 AI 审稿人进行复审，且这些模型家族须不同于研究者所用的。 在发送任何评审之前，我们固定了提示词、输出模式（schema）和脚本。 两个审稿人，Gemini 4 Argon（思考级别为高，配备 Google 搜索工具）和 Muse Wonder（推理力度为最大，配备网络搜索工具），各自在独立的请求中对每篇最终论文评审两次。 它们只能看到论文并可以搜索网络；它们没有被提供代码、数据或记录。 它们被告知这些论文是由一个自主 AI 研究系统生成的。 它们按我们评审指南的六个维度打分，给出结论、按 ICLR 量表（1–10）给出的总分（将该论文视为其所属领域一个强会议上的完整论文）、对论文能否在其领域一个研讨会（录取率约 70%）以及其领域一个顶级会议主赛道（约 25–30%）被录取的判断，并对研究问题进行评级。 这些是仅针对论文本身、未经校准的 AI 评估，并未对照人类决策进行校准，且 20 份评审是对五篇论文的重复评估。 这五篇论文以 PDF 形式发表；Gemini 最初评审的是 Markdown 源文件，此后我们决定由两位审稿人评审作为发表形式的 PDF。 我们将 PDF 评审作为主要结果报告，将 Markdown 评审置于附录 A；这一选择是在看到 Markdown 结果之后做出的。

paragraphs.en: Table 3 lists the questions. All five are societal or environmental questions answered with public data and published model outputs: whether annual satellite embeddings can screen tree-cover change, how much published ensemble summaries constrain the probability that several places exceed a temperature threshold together, how to re-sample reference locations to estimate change in crop diversity, how the allocation of training points affects the recovery of small wetlands in a map, and whether embedding distances add to physical covariates when matching wetlands with similar water regimes. None of the five is about AI itself; four use annual satellite embeddings (AlphaEarth Foundations [ 3 ] and TESSERA [ 4 ] ), which became available in 2025, as one of the objects of study rather than as decoration, and one uses ensemble weather forecasts. Run 015 is a boundary case of the requirement that a question depend on a newly possible capability: its selection record states that the mathematical question could have been studied before 2024 and that the new capability (cheap ensemble forecasts from AI weather models) supplies the motivation and a second class of real forecasts. The agent kept the candidate, as its own judgment of the checks allowed.

paragraphs.en: Run 014: the evaluation moved from the smoothness of embedding trajectories to held-out false alarms and misses, with calibration in earlier years and testing in later years, and gains were reported separately because they were rare.
paragraphs.zh: Run 014：评估从嵌入轨迹的平滑度转向了留出集上的误报与漏报，早期年份用于校准，后期年份用于测试，由于增益很少出现，因此单独报告。

paragraphs.en: Run 015: the decision served by the published summaries was made explicit, and the exact distribution of the number of exceeding sites became the comparison; the critic pointed out, and the agent accepted, that the narrowing of nested bounds is mathematics, not a finding.
paragraphs.zh: Run 015：由已发布摘要所服务的决策被明确化，超标站点数量的精确分布成为比较对象；评审者指出——智能体也接受了——嵌套边界的收窄是数学推导，而非一项发现。

paragraphs.en: Run 016: the reference data were changed from a classified map to farmers’ declarations, because calibrating and validating with the same classified map would share its errors; uncertainty and abstention became primary endpoints.
paragraphs.zh: Run 016：参考数据从分类地图改为农户申报数据，因为使用同一张分类地图进行校准和验证会共享其误差；不确定性和弃权成为主要终点。

paragraphs.en: Run 017: inventory boundaries were treated as near-answer information, an image-only allocation was added as a control, and the endpoint was restricted to the recovery of inventory patches.
paragraphs.zh: Run 017：库存边界被视为近似答案信息，添加了仅图像的分配作为对照，并将终点限制为库存补丁的恢复。

paragraphs.en: Run 018: the central comparison became the increment of embedding distances beyond a strong baseline of public terrain, surface-water and drainage covariates; the question was framed as a label-masked diagnostic of agreement with inventory classes, not of field hydrology.
paragraphs.zh: Run 018：核心比较变为在公共地形、地表水和排水协变量的强基线之上嵌入距离的增量；该问题被构建为一种标签掩码诊断，用于衡量与清单类别的一致性，而非野外水文学。

paragraphs.en: The agents verified the prior work that the critic cited before using it and recorded the points they did not adopt, typically new references they had not checked in full text or proposals for candidates they had rejected.

paragraphs.en: The leading findings concerned interpretation, not execution. In run 014, the adjustment being tested had little to correct, so its null effect was largely predictable. In run 015, much of the result followed from exact moment properties of a 50-member ensemble. In run 016, the same declaration database served as both truth and audit labels. In run 017, the abstract led with the largest of four split estimates and omitted planned conditions with different results. In run 018, the only critical finding of the series: planned null controls (permuted embeddings, other random seeds) produced changes as large as the real embeddings, yet the draft’s abstract presented the increment without applying the qualification rule the agent had itself written before seeing the results. All 40 findings were adopted (29) or partly adopted (11). The agents rewrote abstracts around the answer, added the planned conditions they had omitted, and in run 018 restated the main result as “an increment attributable to the embeddings was not established”. The final versions were not reviewed again.

paragraphs.en: Table 6 summarises the answers. Two of the five main results are negative or null (runs 014 and 018). paragraphs.en: All 20 reviews returned valid output; none reported recognising the papers. Gemini 4 Argon judged all five papers workshop level, with overall scores of 5 or 6 (mean 5.4) and main-track judgments of “borderline” or “no”. Muse Wonder was stricter: overall 3 to 5 (mean 4.1), workshop level “yes” in 3 and “borderline” in 7 of 10 reviews, main track “no” in all, and two “reject” verdicts (runs 014 and 015). The two reviewers disagreed most on run 015 (minor revision and 6/10 versus reject or major revision and 4/10). They agreed on the profile: correctness high (4.4 and 3.8), novelty (3.0 and 2.2), generality (2.6 and 2.0) and clarity (2.3 and 2.0) low, the same profile as the in-loop reviews. They rated the research questions themselves at 3.2 and 3.4 out of 5, and in 19 of 20 reviews they judged the main answer “partly” predictable from the design. Verifiability from the paper alone was rated 4.3 by Gemini and 2.8 by Muse, below the in-loop 5.0; the in-loop reviewer had the records, but it was also a different model and reviewed the first drafts. The two reviews of the same paper differed by 0.4 (Gemini) and 0.6 (Muse) points overall on average.
paragraphs.zh: 全部 20 份评审都返回了有效输出，没有任何一份报告识别出这些论文。 Gemini 4 Argon 将全部五篇论文评为研讨会级别，总分均为 5 或 6（均值 5.4），主赛道判定为“边缘”或“否”。 Muse Wonder 更为严格：总分为 3 到 5（均值 4.1），在 10 份评审中研讨会级别 3 次为“是”、7 次为“边缘”，主赛道全部为“否”，并且给出两次“拒稿”结论（第 014 和 015 次运行）。 两位评审在第 015 次运行上分歧最大（小修与 6/10 对比拒稿或大修与 4/10）。 两者对画像的评价一致：正确性较高（4.4 和 3.8），新颖性（3.0 和 2.2）、普适性（2.6 和 2.0）和清晰度（2.3 和 2.0）较低，与环路内评审的画像相同。 两者对研究问题本身的评分为 5 分制下的 3.2 和 3.4，并且在 20 份评审中有 19 份判定主要答案从设计只能“部分”预测。 仅凭论文的可验证性被 Gemini 评为 4.3、Muse 评为 2.8，低于环路内的 5.0；环路内评审者拥有记录，但那也是不同的模型，并且评审的是初稿。 对同一篇论文的两份评审在总分上平均相差 0.4 分（Gemini）和 0.6 分（Muse）。

paragraphs.en: With a plain agent, an instruction document and two skills, five consecutive runs formulated their own questions and carried them through to revised, re-computable papers without research input from people. The human set only the area, in one or two sentences; neither the specific question nor the outputs to report were chosen by people, which makes the AI’s choices observable.
paragraphs.zh: 使用一个简单的智能体、一份说明文档和两个技能，连续五次运行都自行拟定研究问题，并推进到修订后可重新计算的论文，全程无需人类提供研究输入。 人类仅用一两句话设定研究领域；无论是具体问题还是要报告的输出都不由人类选择，这使得AI的选择是可观察的。

paragraphs.en: Within the technology × \times societal-problem setting, the agents chose societal and environmental questions on public data, and the technology-first procedure pulled them toward a small set of well-documented resources. The area itself came from the instructions: in the development runs, the same research model chose caches and document retrieval when the field was computer science, and societal problems after one sentence was changed (Section 4 ). Within the area, the convergence is partly a property of the procedure (a recent technology with public outputs and public ground truth) and partly of the model; we did not vary the model in this series. It suggests that an AI researcher’s agenda, once the area is set, concentrates where data and outputs are open. Leaving the question to the AI therefore does not remove the human choice of area; it makes that choice small, explicit and testable.
paragraphs.zh: 在「技术 × \times 社会问题」的设定中，各智能体在公开数据上选择了社会与环境方面的问题，而以技术为先的流程把它们引向了一小部分文献完备的资源。 领域本身来自指令：在开发性运行中，同一个研究模型在领域为计算机科学时选择了缓存与文档检索，而仅改动一句话后就转向了社会问题（第 4 节）。 在该领域内部，这种趋同一部分是流程本身的属性（一项近期技术，具有公开的输出与公开的真值），一部分是模型的属性；我们在这一系列实验中并未更换模型。 这表明，一旦领域确定，AI 研究者的研究议程就会集中在数据与输出公开的地方。 因此，把问题留给 AI 并不会取消人类对领域的选择；它使这一选择变得微小、明确且可检验。

paragraphs.en: The critic, consulted after short feasibility probes but before the main plan, shaped what was compared and what was claimed; the reviewer, with the records, checked that the claims followed from the evidence and that planned analyses were reported. Novelty and generality of the final papers remained low in both external reviews; since we did not evaluate the papers before and after the critique and the review, we cannot estimate how either affected them. The weakest point of the system remains the choice of a question whose answer matters and is not fixed by the design.
paragraphs.zh: 评审者在短期可行性探测之后、主计划之前被咨询，塑造了比较的内容和声明的内容；审阅者则依据记录，核查这些声明是否由证据推出，以及计划中的分析是否被报告。 最终论文的新颖性与通用性在两次外部评审中均保持较低；由于我们没有在评论与审阅之前和之后对论文进行评估，因此无法估计二者对论文的影响。 该系统最薄弱的一点仍然是选择一个其答案有实际意义且不由设计所固定的研究问题。

paragraphs.en: Execution did not prevent completion in these five runs, which chose their questions partly for feasibility. A separate reviewer agent re-ran every first draft, and every finding was answered within the response period. The remaining problems, as in our development runs, were in framing: which estimate leads the abstract, whether controls are given their planned weight, and whether the answer was predictable.
paragraphs.zh: 在这五次运行中，执行并未阻碍完成，因为这些运行在选择问题时部分考虑了可行性。 一个单独的审阅智能体重新运行了每一份初稿，每一项发现都在响应期限内得到了回应。 剩下的问题，正如在我们开发运行中一样，在于框架：哪个估计引领摘要、控制组是否被赋予其计划中的权重，以及答案是否可以预测。

paragraphs.en: The area setting deserves its own experiments. All five evaluation runs used one setting, a new technology applied to a societal problem. Settings other than technology × \times societal problems remain to be tested, for example a named scientific field, a given dataset, theoretical questions, or the open decision of a particular user, as does a setting with no hint at all, which would separate the effect of removing the field from that of adding the hint. A more specific setting may also yield more specific themes, and whether the procedure then still produces non-obvious questions is open. A human evaluation of the five papers is planned separately.
paragraphs.zh: 领域设定值得单独进行实验。 全部五次评估运行都使用了同一种设定，即一项应用于社会问题的新技术。 技术 × \times 社会问题之外的其他设定仍有待测试，例如某个具体的科学领域、某个给定的数据集、理论问题，或某个特定用户的开放决策；完全不提供提示的设定同样有待测试，这种设定可以将移除领域的影响与添加提示的影响区分开来。 更具体的设定也可能产生更具体的主题，而届时该流程是否仍能产生非显而易见的问题仍是未知数。 对这五篇论文的人工评估将另行安排。

paragraphs.en: Five runs with one research model are a small sample, and we made no ablation, so we cannot attribute outcomes to the question procedure, the critic or the reviewer. All evaluations are by AI models; a human evaluation is planned separately. The in-loop reviewer is from the same family as the management agent. We counted the pilot run after seeing three results, and we chose the PDF reviews as the main external result after seeing the Markdown reviews; both are reported as deviations. The external reviewers read only the papers, so their verifiability scores do not reflect the records. Topic selection consulted a critique by another model, and the hint toward societal problems in the instructions shaped the domain. The lessons on the area setting (Section 4 ) come from development runs in which the research model, its environment and other parts of the instructions also changed, so they are observations rather than controlled comparisons. Re-computation by the reviewer re-ran the agent’s own code on the first draft; it is not an independent implementation, and it does not establish the correctness of reference labels or the validity of interpretations. Isolation from earlier runs relied on separate configuration and on the instructions, not on access control. The external ratings are uncalibrated AI judgments of the papers alone. This paper was drafted by the management agent from the records (Appendix B ).

paragraphs.en: A coding agent given an instruction document and two skills can formulate its own research question and carry it through to a revised, verifiable paper, repeatedly and without research input from people. AI reviewers reading only the papers judged them favourably or borderline for a workshop in their fields and below the main track, without calibration against human decisions, and rated their novelty and generality low. In our development runs, what kind of research resulted shifted with the one or two sentences that set the research area, and within that area depended on the procedure that forms the question. Formulating questions that matter is where autonomous research agents now need the most work, and leaving the question to them is how to study it.
paragraphs.zh: 一个编码智能体在给定指令文档和两项技能的情况下，能够自己提出研究问题，并将其推进到一份经过修订、可验证的论文，而且可以反复进行，无需人类提供研究方面的输入。 仅阅读论文的AI审稿人认为这些论文适合其领域的一个workshop、低于主会水平，给出了正面或边缘的评价，且未对照人类决策进行校准，同时它们对论文的新颖性和通用性评分较低。 在我们的开发运行中，产出了什么样的研究随着设定研究领域的那一两句话而变化，而在该领域之内则取决于形成问题的具体流程。 提出重要的问题正是自主研究智能体目前最需要改进的地方，而把问题留给它们正是研究这一点的途径。

paragraphs.en: Before the papers were converted to PDF, Gemini 4 Argon reviewed their Markdown sources with the figures attached as images (same prompt except for one sentence on the input form; two reviews per paper). The ten reviews gave mean scores of 4.4 (correctness), 4.3 (verifiability), 2.9 (novelty), 2.7 (generality), 3.4 (usefulness) and 2.4 (clarity), and an overall score of 5.4, close to the PDF reviews. The prompts, schema, scripts, raw responses and costs are in the repository.
